notes: "Roon to Spotify seems unresponsive" — and it was worse than slow. A search that could not be MADE was being reported as a search that found nothing: a rate-limited lookup became an amber "not found" row and was CACHED, so it would have reported a library as absent from Spotify and a re-run would not even have retried. Those are red "failed" rows now, quoting what the service actually said, and never cached. A run whose searches never once work stops in the first minute instead of grinding for days. The 429 backoff no longer waits LESS than Spotify asked for — which was turning one rate-limit into a cascade of them — and one worker's 429 now holds the other three instead of all four resuming together. And the page says it: "Spotify is rate limiting this app — waiting 30s (7 so far)", with a count of the waits, because a throttled run and a hung one looked identical from the outside. The Roon-to-Qobuz report that came with this found 80.3% of 9,635 albums and no broken reads at all.
